# The original research data are not included in this repository. This document is intended to demonstrate the statistical workflow and code organization used for the analysis.

# Biomarker Linear Mixed Model 

```{r package}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(nlme)
library(emmeans)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
```

# Import Data File

```{r-import-data-file}
df <- read_excel(
  "Data/Biomarkers.xlsx",
  sheet = "Sheet1",
  na = c("", "NA", "#DIV/0!")
)
names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
```

# CRP Linear Mixed Model

## CRP Cleaning

```{r-crp-cleaning}
df_CRP <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Status = trimws(as.character(Status)),
    ID = factor(ID),
    Timepoint = factor(trimws(Timepoint),
                       levels = c("Before", "Immediate")),
    Trial = factor(Group, levels = c("SHAM", "IPC")),
    CRP = as.numeric(CRP),
    Vert_Gain = as.numeric(Vert_Gain),
    Average_Elevation = as.numeric(Average_Elevation),
    AQ = as.numeric(AQ)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(Status) | Status != "Dropped",
    !is.na(CRP),
    CRP > 0,
    !is.na(Vert_Gain),
    !is.na(Average_Elevation),
    !is.na(AQ)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()
```

## CRP Model

```{r-crp-model}
model_CRP<- lme(
  fixed = log(CRP) ~ Timepoint * Trial +
    Vert_Gain +
    Average_Elevation +
    AQ,
  random = ~ 1 | ID,
  data = df_CRP,
  na.action = na.omit
)

summary(model_CRP)
anova(model_CRP)
```

## Moderation analysis using a linear mixed-effects model

```{r-moderation-analysis-vert-int }
model_CRP_vert_int <- lme(
  fixed = log(CRP) ~ Timepoint * Vert_Gain + Trial + Average_Elevation + AQ,
  random = ~ 1 | ID,
  data = df_CRP,
  method = "REML",
  na.action = na.omit
)

anova(model_CRP_vert_int)
```

```{r-moderation-analysis-elev-int}
model_CRP_elev_int <- lme(
  fixed = log(CRP) ~ Timepoint * Average_Elevation + Trial + Vert_Gain + AQ,
  random = ~ 1 | ID,
  data = df_CRP,
  method = "REML",
  na.action = na.omit
)

anova(model_CRP_elev_int)
```

## CRP Diagnostics

```{r-crp-diagnostics}
check_model(model_CRP)
check_collinearity(model_CRP)

resid_CRP <- residuals(model_CRP, type = "normalized")

hist(resid_CRP,
     main = "Histogram of normalized residuals",
     xlab = "Normalized residuals")

qqnorm(resid_CRP)
qqline(resid_CRP)

shapiro.test(resid_CRP)
```

## CRP Emmeans

```{r-crp-emmeans}
emm_CRP <- emmeans(model_CRP, ~ Timepoint * Trial)

emm_CRP
pairs(emm_CRP)

# Before vs Immediate within each trial
pairs(emm_CRP, by = "Trial")

# IPC vs SHAM at each timepoint
pairs(emm_CRP, by = "Timepoint")

emmeans(model_CRP, ~ Timepoint * Trial, type = "response")
```

## Effect Size

```{r-effect-size}
emm_CRP_trial <- emmeans(
  model_CRP,
  ~ Trial | Timepoint
)

eff_size(
  emm_CRP_trial,
  sigma = as.numeric(sigma(model_CRP)),
  edf = Inf
)
```

# IL-10 Linear Mixed Model

## IL-10 Cleaning

```{r-il-10-cleaning}
df_il10 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Status = trimws(as.character(Status)),
    ID = factor(ID),
    Timepoint = factor(trimws(Timepoint),
                       levels = c("Before", "Immediate")),
    Trial = factor(Group, levels = c("SHAM", "IPC")),
    IL10 = as.numeric(IL_10),
    Vert_Gain = as.numeric(Vert_Gain),
    Average_Elevation = as.numeric(Average_Elevation),
    AQ = as.numeric(AQ)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(Status) | Status != "Dropped",
    !is.na(IL10),
    IL10 > 0,
    !is.na(Vert_Gain),
    !is.na(Average_Elevation),
    !is.na(AQ)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()
```

## IL-10 Model

```{r-il-10-model}
model_il10<- lme(
  fixed = log(IL10) ~ Timepoint * Trial +
    Vert_Gain +
    Average_Elevation +
    AQ,
  random = ~ 1 | ID,
  data = df_il10,
  na.action = na.omit
)

summary(model_il10)
anova(model_il10)
```

## IL-10 Diagnostics

```{r-il-10-diagnostics}
check_model(model_il10)
check_collinearity(model_il10)

resid_il10 <- residuals(model_il10, type = "normalized")

hist(resid_il10,
     main = "Histogram of normalized residuals",
     xlab = "Normalized residuals")

qqnorm(resid_il10)
qqline(resid_il10)

shapiro.test(resid_il10)

df_il10_diag <- df_il10 %>%
  mutate(
    resid_il10 = residuals(model_il10, type = "normalized"),
    fitted_il10 = fitted(model_il10)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(resid_il10)))

df_il10_diag %>%
  select(ID, Timepoint, Trial, IL10, resid_il10, fitted_il10, Vert_Gain, Average_Elevation, AQ)

```

```{r-il-10-emmeans}

# IPC vs SHAM at each timepoint
pairs(emm_il10, by = "Timepoint")

emmeans(model_il10, ~ Timepoint * Trial, type = "response")
```

# Graphs: Whisker Plot

## Load the clean data

```{r-load-the-clean-data}
df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Status = trimws(as.character(Status)),
    ID = factor(ID),
    Timepoint = factor(trimws(Timepoint),
                       levels = c("Before", "Immediate")),
    Trial = factor(Group, levels = c("SHAM", "IPC")),
    IL_6 = as.numeric(IL_6),
    IL_10 = as.numeric(IL_10),
    TNF_alpha = as.numeric(TNF_alpha_clean),
    CRP = as.numeric(CRP) / 1000000,   # convert pg/mL to mg/L
    TAC = as.numeric(TAC)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(Status) | Status != "Dropped"
  )
```

## Convert biomarkers to long format

```{r-convert-biomarkers-to-long-format}
bio_long <- df_clean %>%
  select(ID, Timepoint, Trial, IL_6, IL_10, TNF_alpha, CRP, TAC) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(IL_6, IL_10, TNF_alpha, CRP, TAC),
    names_to = "Biomarker",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Value),
    Value > 0
  )
```

## Create a function for each panel

```{r-create-a-function-for-each-panel}
make_panel <- function(data, biomarker_name, panel_label, y_label) {
  
  ggplot(
    data %>% filter(Biomarker == biomarker_name),
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = Value, fill = Trial)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
      width = 0.45,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black",
      coef = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = Trial),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.08,
        dodge.width = 0.55
      ),
      size = 2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = Trial),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "line",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = Trial),
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
      color = "black",
      size = 2
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(
      breaks = scales::breaks_log(n = 5),
      labels = scales::label_number()
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("SHAM" = "white", "IPC" = "gray40")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("SHAM" = 17, "IPC" = 17)) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label,
      tag = panel_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## Make each panel

```{r-make-each-panel}
p_il6 <- make_panel(
  bio_long,
  biomarker_name = "IL_6",
  panel_label = "A",
  y_label = "IL-6 (pg/mL)"
)

p_il10 <- make_panel(
  bio_long,
  biomarker_name = "IL_10",
  panel_label = "B",
  y_label = "IL-10 (pg/mL)"
)

p_tnf <- make_panel(
  bio_long,
  biomarker_name = "TNF_alpha",
  panel_label = "C",
  y_label = expression("TNF-"*alpha*" (pg/mL)")
)

p_crp <- make_panel(
  bio_long,
  biomarker_name = "CRP",
  panel_label = "D",
  y_label = "CRP (mg/L)"
)

p_tac <- make_panel(
  bio_long,
  biomarker_name = "TAC",
  panel_label = "E",
  y_label = "TAC (U/mL)"
)
```

## Combine panels like your figure

```{r-vombine-panels-like-your-figure}
figure_biomarkers <- 
  (p_il6 | p_il10) /
  (p_tnf | p_crp) /
  (p_tac | plot_spacer())

figure_biomarkers
```

## Save the figure

```{r-save-the-figure}

dir.create("outputs/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = "outputs/figures/Figure_Biomarkers.png",
  plot = figure_biomarkers,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  filename = "outputs/figures/Figure_Biomarkers.tiff",
  plot = figure_biomarkers,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```
